Glossary / Support
Glossary · Technical analysis

Support सपोर्ट

A price level where buying has tended to appear and stop further falls.

हिंदी में: सपोर्ट

वह कीमत स्तर जहाँ ख़रीदारी दिखी है और आगे गिरावट रुकी है।

How it is used in the lessons

A breakout on high volume usually has more support than the same move on low volume.

From Reading Charts

Is it at a support or resistance level, or in the middle of nowhere?

From Candlestick and Chart Patterns
